Our Technology Architecture

# Put Contract Intelligence to work at enterprise scale.

Luminance combines legal data, encoded expertise, and purpose-built intelligence to understand contracts, validate conclusions, and support confident decisions across the enterprise. This foundation powers AI agents that orchestrate multi-step contract work at scale, automating repeatable tasks while maintaining control.

[Request a demo](https://www.luminance.com/#get-started)

## AI is only as strong as its architecture

Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate an answer. They can’t reliably determine which contracts matter, what your business has agreed, how terms connect, which legal position applies or whether their conclusion is supported by evidence.

A trusted answer requires the right context, legal expertise, task-specific intelligence, structured reasoning, and independent validation. Every stage introduces opportunities for mistakes, from missing context and unsuitable models to legal inaccuracies and unvalidated outputs.

Improving one stage is not enough. Every stage must be engineered to work together, from retrieving evidence and applying legal expertise to selecting the right intelligence, reasoning over the answer and validating the result.

That is Contract Intelligence: an architecture that understands contracts in context, connects the knowledge within them and produces answers you can rely on - while enabling AI agents to apply that intelligence consistently across the breadth of enterprise workflows.

THE KNOWLEDGE LAYER

## Document Search Engine

[Explore](https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology/document-search-engine)

Pre-computed legal knowledge and Context Graphs connect contracts, amendments and related documents, enabling users and AI agents to retrieve the right evidence faster and analyze transactions in context.

the routing layer

## Model-Opinionated

[Explore](https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology/model-opinionated)

A multi-model architecture routes each task to the intelligence best suited to its accuracy, speed, reliability and cost requirements, without dependence on a single model or provider.

The Validation Layer

## Differential Validation

[Explore](https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology/differential-validation)

Independent judges, grounded critics, and task-specific checks scrutinize high-impact outputs against evidence, improving accuracy, and making uncertainty visible when human review is required.

The Specialist Intelligence Layer

## Luna Crescent

[Explore](https://www.luminance.com/platform/technology/luna)

Luminance’s proprietary LLM, Luna Crescent, is purpose-built for specialist legal tasks, improving the speed and economics of high-volume contract extraction, classification and analysis.

Data, Expertise, and Engineering

## Built on legal intelligence. Designed for enterprise action.

Contract Intelligence starts with the right foundations: proprietary legal data, encoded expertise and the engineering experience to turn both into reliable intelligence.

Luminance has spent more than a decade putting AI into production and learning what it takes to understand contracts in context, retrieve the right information, select the right intelligence and validate critical outputs. These foundations are embedded across the platform, supporting confident decisions and action across the enterprise.

foundation

## Why purpose-built architecture matters

General-purpose models continue to improve. Enterprise Contract Intelligence requires an architecture that understands contracts in context, retrieves the right evidence, selects the right model for each task and validates the result.

It's the architecture built around them.

For technology leaders, the critical question is how the platform manages context, legal expertise, model selection, validation, security, and control.

our vision

## Built by AI experts from the University of Cambridge.

More than a decade later, our teams continue to work at the intersection of AI, engineering, and law, researching new approaches, evaluating the latest models, and turning advances in AI into technology that works for real contract workflows.

The models will continue to change. The expertise behind how Luminance engineers and applies them continues to compound.

## Security engineered for the enterprise

ISO 27001

Luminance maintains an independently certified Information Security Management System covering the development, operation, sales, and support of its technology platform.

SOC 2 TYPE II

Luminance undergoes regular SOC 2 Type II examinations to provide ongoing independent assurance over controls related to security, availability, and confidentiality.

Independent Penetration Testing

Independent third parties regularly test the Luminance application and operational systems against evolving threats. Further information is available through the security review process.
